Congressman Brecheen’s absence during the impeachment vote aligns with his consistent record of rejecting political theater. His opposition to the $7 trillion reconciliation bill earlier this year—joining Democrats to block reckless deficit spending—proves he prioritizes fiscal sanity over performative gestures. The failed impeachment push was pure partisan distraction, wasting time while real issues like Biden’s border crisis and $36 trillion debt spiral demand action.

Brecheen’s stance mirrors the America First agenda: cut waste, secure borders, and stop D.C.’s addiction to bloated budgets. If leadership had needed his vote to kill this sham, he’d have been there—but the motion was dead on arrival.

Focus should be on dismantling bureaucratic bloat, not resurrecting failed impeachment stunts.
